name: freewin-xyz-worker
description: This package.json exists ONLY to provide a standard `npm test` entry point for the zero-dependency test suite added under /test. It intentionally has no dependencies -- the tests run against Node's built-in test runner (node:test) and built-in node:sqlite (Node 22+), not against any installed package. The actual Worker itself has no build step and is deployed as plain JS via wrangler, same as before this file existed.
